//type: Deliberately NOT "module". commitlint.config.js at the repo root is CommonJS, and it is read by two things outside this package: the commit-msg hook in .pre-commit-config.yaml and Super-Linter's GIT_COMMITLINT validator. An application added later should declare its own type in its own workspace package.json rather than flipping it here.
